description: Land Redemption - Biyanwila, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically revokes a previous order regarding the acquisition of specified land allotments, provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels including lot numbers, extents, and boundaries, and is published in the "PART III – LANDS" section. The mention of the Minister's name and title is incidental to the land-related administrative action rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
